<description>
SignPSBTInput() assumes SIGHASH_DEFAULT for a taproot input when
neither PSBT_IN_SIGHASH_TYPE nor the caller's sighash_type is set.
Its check of existing signatures then rejected every 65-byte
taproot signature, so a PSBT holding a valid SIGHASH_ALL signature
could be neither finalized nor signed further.

When neither the field nor the parameter is set, the default is only
assumed, so also accept a 65-byte signature ending in SIGHASH_ALL.
NONE, SINGLE and ANYONECANPAY variants are still rejected, as are
all mismatches when the field or the parameter is set.

Fixes #36507.
